parents.subject: Russian, East European and Eurasian Studies

ns2:section.sectionText: Survey of critical approaches in dance studies including feminist theory, poststructural, and postcolonial theory, historiography, and ethnographic research methods. Course topics will cover a variety of theatrical, popular, and social dance practices. Course may be repeated to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours and 9 graduate hours. Prerequisite: DANC 440 or consent of instructor. Meets with Dance 441.
